claims.statement: An approval for one shell tool call cannot authorize a later call that reuses the same provider call id, and adapter-generated ids for missing or empty provider ids remain distinct.
claims.authority: Frozen pilot contract derived from the existing user-facing approval policy and the expected safe side effects; this runner cannot alter the expected outcomes.

expectedCases: an approved shell call does not approve a later call that reuses its id when the provider repeats call_0
an approved shell call does not approve a later call that reuses its id when the provider repeats its own id
an approved shell call does not approve a later call when the chat-completions provider omits tool call ids
an approved shell call does not approve a later call when the chat-completions provider sends empty tool call ids
mustAssert: the first GREEN unsandboxed command runs and writes exactly 'approved\n'
the subsequent RED rm command is refused and its victim file remains exactly 'must survive\n'
the CLI reports two distinct approval decisions and the RED refusal reason
all four provider-id, repeated-id, omitted-id, and empty-id scenarios pass
the provider receives both calls and paired tool results
